zh-CN.name: 冰箱库存管理
zh-CN.eyebrow: 给日常做饭，留一点清楚
zh-CN.headline: 冰箱里有什么，看一眼照片就知道。
zh-CN.lead: 买回来的食材拍一张，冷藏、冷冻、常温各归其位。下次做饭前，顺手看看还剩多少。
zh-CN.preview: 开发预览，尚未正式发布
zh-CN.howTitle: 不用把生活，填成一张表。
zh-CN.photoBody: 不用填写名称和数量。选好储存区域，可连续拍摄，也能从相册一次加入多张照片。
zh-CN.reviewBody: 每次整理，只确认你看过的食材；没了就移到历史，也可以撤销。
zh-CN.reminderBody: 按记录的检查间隔提醒，处理后开启下一周期。未处理的仍留在待检查列表。
zh-CN.foodSafety: 检查提醒，不是保质期判断
zh-CN.localTitle: 记录轻一点，边界说清楚。
zh-CN.localBody: 照片、库存和历史保存在本机。无需账号密码，不做食材识别或云同步。
zh-CN.networkBody: 游客身份、反馈和必要产品分析通过 Shared Platform 接入中，不因此上传食材照片或库存。
zh-CN.dataLoss: 卸载或清除数据可能丢失本机记录；提醒不构成食品安全结论。
zh-CN.availabilityBody: 查看开发版本和发布状态。尚未发布的渠道暂不提供安装入口。

en.name: Fridge Inventory
en.eyebrow: A little clarity for everyday cooking
en.headline: See what’s in your fridge, one photo at a time.
en.lead: Photograph your groceries and keep chilled, frozen and pantry food in their places. Before cooking, check what’s left.
en.howTitle: Keep track without filling out a spreadsheet.
en.photoBody: No names or quantities to enter. Choose a storage zone, take consecutive photos or add several from your album.
en.reviewBody: Review only the food you have checked. Move finished items to history, with an option to undo.
en.reminderTitle: A reminder when it’s time to check.
en.reminderBody: Each record has a check interval. Handling it starts a new cycle; pending items stay on the checklist.
en.foodSafety: A check reminder, not an expiry assessment
en.localBody: Photos, inventory and history stay on your device. No password is required. There is no food recognition or cloud sync.
en.networkBody: Guest identity, feedback and essential product analytics are being connected through Shared Platform. Food photos and inventory are not uploaded for this.
en.dataLoss: Uninstalling or clearing data may erase local records. Reminders do not determine food safety.
en.availabilityBody: Check development builds and release status here. Unreleased channels have no installation link yet.
en.wechatHint: If the download does not start inside WeChat, open this page in your system browser and retry.
en.legalNotice: The legal text is currently a Chinese review draft and is not yet in effect.
en.websitePrivacyBody: Accept this website’s terms and privacy policy to allow anonymous counts of app entry actions. Statistics send no sign-in credentials or cookies. You can still browse and download without accepting.
en.androidPreviewKind: Debug APK · not hardened · development preview only
